description: An activity type: what it is called, who may log it, what it asks, and when it counts as complete.

fields.description: The name reps see, and who this activity is for. A lead outside the product line, group and programme named here cannot be given this activity.
fields.label: Identity & Grain

fields.description: Everything that can block a bad save: when a location is required, whether submitting completes the task, and whether bulk completion is allowed.
fields.label: Enforcement

fields.description: In-Person marks this as a visit, which requires a location at save. Blank or Phone does not.
fields.label: Visit Mode

fields.description: Require a location when this question's answer meets the condition below. Blank leaves Visit Mode to decide.
fields.label: Location Required When

fields.description: The comparison applied to the answer.
fields.label: Operator
fields.options:
is
is not
is set
is not set

fields.description: The answer compared against. Ignored by is set and is not set.
fields.label: Value

fields.description: The task is completed as soon as its form is submitted. Off, it stays an open to-do.
fields.label: Logged Complete

fields.description: Force completion through the form, one task at a time.
fields.label: Disable Bulk Complete

fields.description: One row per question the form asks. Row order is form order.
fields.label: Fields

fields.description: The questions this activity asks, in order. Empty means a plain task with no form.
fields.label: Schema

fields.description: One row per reaction: when an answer matches, the listed questions are shown, hidden or made mandatory. A blank When sets the form's opening state.
fields.label: Rules

name: CRM Task Type
